description: This file contains utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and storing valid tokens in a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a source string into tokens based on spaces and stores valid tokens in a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes the validity check.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is not empty.
